ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the food web diagram, Brown Bear is at the top, and Salmon is located in the middle-lower position; below Salmon there is a plant labeled “Flower, Grass, or water plant”. In the figure there is an arrow from Salmon pointing to the “Flower, Grass, or water plant” below. Reasoning: The question asks if there were no salmon, which population would increase. According to the food web relationship, after salmon disappear, the objects it feeds on would have reduced pressure from being preyed on or eaten, so the Flower/Grass/water plant population below would increase.
